description: This file defines the ColumnCellIterator class, which is used to iterate over cells in a specific column within a worksheet in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages iteration over the cells in a specified column and range of rows, providing methods to seek, rewind, move forward or backward, and validate the current position in the iteration.

classes.name: ColumnCellIterator
classes.description: An iterator class to traverse cells in a specific worksheet column within a specified row range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with the worksheet, target column, start row, and optional end row.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting row pointer for iteration.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the ending row for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current position to a specific row within the iteration range.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start row.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current cell in the iteration.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the valid range.

methods.name: adjustForExistingOnlyRange
methods.description: Adjusts the start and end ranges to only include existing cells if the mode is enabled.
